title: Microsoft: Windows Server 2016 reaches end of support in January
description: Microsoft announced that Windows Server 2016 will reach its end of support in January 2027, after which it will no longer receive security updates or patches.
aiSummary: Windows Server 2016 will stop receiving security updates from Microsoft starting January 2027, marking the end of its official support lifecycle. This means that any newly discovered vulnerabilities in this operating system version will not be addressed by Microsoft through patches or security fixes.
aiImpact: After January 2027, Windows Server 2016 systems will be exposed to unpatched security vulnerabilities, increasing the risk of exploitation if attackers discover new flaws. Organizations continuing to use this version beyond the end of support date will not receive official security updates, potentially leading to increased security risks.
